conclusions: Frozen candidate changes fixture production only: the existing actual225 login boundary, independent material snapshot, actual-current-migration prerequisite and both test bodies are byte-identical to exact4664c581.

Fixture input is the exact independently captured TEST_ONLY historical owner output. Embedded SHA256 is checked before any database work; format, producer SHA, version, subject/audit uniqueness and fixed table roster are checked. No expected rows are synthesized from current implementation output.

Actual numbered migrations run to225 through existing migration LOGIN; runtime checksums are compared against all225 frozen SHA384 checksums. This reviewer independently recomputed every captured checksum from exact4664c581 Git blobs.

Nine fixed INSERT SELECT statements use actual225 PostgreSQL composite table types through jsonb_populate_recordset. Native bytea, timestamptz, arrays and JSON conversions remain database-owned, with exact affected-row assertions and no conflict suppression.

Group and organization parents precede users and auth children; refresh families precede one four-token INSERT so normal self-FK replaced_by checks can resolve all referenced token rows within the same statement.

Actual migration225 organization INSERT trigger creates memberships. Candidate proves the exact two captured group/org key pairs before restoring only original created_at; complete membership rows are then compared with capture. No membership, Account or schema authority is fabricated.

All ten full native row rosters are read back and compared against frozen capture inside the transaction, together with migration version/checksums, empty unused fixture edges, two credentials, four tokens, two replacement links and one revoked family.
The retained raw synthetic token is hashed and required to match a restored revoked token and revoked family. Raw token and credential material were never printed by this reviewer.

After commit, the unchanged original material_snapshot must equal the frozen captured projection before any current migration begins. Postcommit mismatch leaves only failed disposable test state and fails the test; it cannot become a passing oracle.
No new migration-ledger writes, grants, ALTER TABLE, trigger disabling, constraint disabling, conflict suppression or fake accounts/account_security/company_actors DDL/DML appear in the proposal.

The original exact ACCOUNT_CATALOG_PREREQUISITE, mapping assertion, byte-preservation comparison and FamilyRevoked-only denial oracle remain unchanged. The proposal does not hide the historical missing company_actors failure.
